ask: What's waiting in the Library? Approve the one about onboarding.

steps.why: Library posts wait here like other drafts. Rows with is_library true or a library_topic are posts for the employee Library link; test this first (they also carry a cascade_name) and show them as one Library group, each with its topic and full text. The user has not seen the onboarding post yet, so show its full text and ask: "This is the onboarding one. Approve it for the Library?" Approve only on their yes to that text.

One post is one item. approve_only and no fixed_time: a Library post is never scheduled. Read the item: ok with scheduled false and a status other than Approved means it went to the client (it was made with "send to the client"); otherwise it is live on the link. image_pending: the image is still being made, so wait and approve again. client_review_pending: the client already has it and decides it.

say: Approved for Acme: the onboarding post is live on your Library link, so your team can open it there and share it. (If it went to the client: "Sent to your client for review; it goes live on your Library link when they approve.")
never: Approving before the user has seen the post's full text and said yes to it.
Passing a time, or calling publish-post for a Library post: it refuses it, with any when.
Saying a Library post is scheduled.
Approving again when Bolta says the image is still being made or the client already has it.
